name: airbnb-microservices
description: Airbnb microservices monorepo — API Gateway + 4 domain services

scripts.dev:services: concurrently --names "GATEWAY,HOTEL,BOOKING,NOTIF,REVIEW" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgCyan.bold" --timestamp-format "HH:mm:ss" --prefix "[{name}][{time}]" --kill-others-on-fail false "cd AuthServiceInGo && go run main.go" "npm --prefix HotelService run dev" "npm --prefix BookingService run dev" "npm --prefix NotificationService run dev" "cd ReviewService && go run main.go"
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run dev:services
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix HotelService install && npm --prefix BookingService install && npm --prefix NotificationService install
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build -d
